# Verbs

The controlled vocabulary of spec §7. The registry is deliberately small: a module reuses an existing verb whenever the semantics match, and spec §40.1 requires a review before a new one is added.

| verb | meaning | typical targets | pipeline role | mutates |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `get` | Obtain current objects or state. | process, file, service, socket, user | producer | no |
| `find` | Discover by search criteria or location. | file, host, command, package | producer | no |
| `inspect` | Expose a detailed representation and its provenance. | any object | transform/terminal | no |
| `watch` | Observe repeatedly or live. | query, process, file, service | stream producer | no |
| `trace` | Derive relationships, path or provenance. | process, service, host, packet | producer/view | no |
| `start` | Transition into a running or active state. | service, job, container | consumer | yes |
| `stop` | Transition into a stopped or inactive state. | service, process, job | consumer | yes |
| `restart` | Stop and start again with target semantics. | service, container | consumer | yes |
| `kill` | Deliver a termination signal or forceful stop. | process, job | consumer | yes |
| `open` | Open a resource in its associated handler or context. | file, URL, device | consumer | yes |
| `enter` | Make a resource the active interaction context. | dir, container, service | context | no |
| `leave` | Pop the active context. | context | context | no |
| `connect` | Create a protocol connection. | host, socket, database | consumer/context | yes |
| `link` | Create and persist an Ono remote execution link. | host, session | context | yes |
| `detach` | Leave a live or remote attachment without stopping the target. | link, job, stream | context | no |
| `add` | Create a membership or association. | user, route, group, repo | mutation | yes |
| `remove` | Delete a resource or a membership. | file, route, package | mutation | yes |
| `set` | Modify properties or configuration. | env, service, file metadata | mutation | yes |
| `move` | Relocate an object. | file, dir | mutation | yes |
| `copy` | Duplicate an object. | file, dir | mutation | yes |
| `rename` | Change an identity label or name. | file, link | mutation | yes |
| `mount` | Attach a filesystem or resource. | filesystem | mutation | yes |
| `unmount` | Detach a filesystem or resource. | filesystem | mutation | yes |
| `send` | Emit data, a signal or a message. | signal, packet, notification | consumer | yes |
| `read` | Consume content rather than metadata. | file, stream, secret | producer | no |
| `write` | Create or replace content. | file, stream | consumer | yes |
| `tail` | Follow append-oriented content. | file, journal | stream | no |
| `test` | Evaluate a condition or a capability. | port, path, permission | producer | no |
| `resolve` | Map a name or identifier. | dns, user, path, command | producer | no |
| `format` | Render explicitly for a human. | any value | transform | no |
| `to` | Serialize or convert. | json, yaml, csv, text, bytes | transform | no |
| `from` | Parse an explicit representation. | json, yaml, csv | transform | no |
| `select` | Project fields. | records | transform | no |
| `where` | Filter values. | stream, list | transform | no |
| `sort` | Order values. | stream, list | transform | no |
| `group` | Group by an expression. | stream, list | transform | no |
| `take` | Take the first N values. | stream, list | transform | no |
| `skip` | Skip the first N values. | stream, list | transform | no |
| `each` | Execute an expression or block per value. | stream, list | transform | no |
| `reduce` | Fold a stream into a single value. | stream, list | transform | no |
| `count` | Count values. | stream, list | terminal/transform | no |
| `measure` | Calculate statistics. | numeric stream | transform | no |
| `join` | Perform a relational join. | records, tables | transform | no |
| `diff` | Compare values or state. | file, record, query | producer/view | no |
| `help` | Discover documentation. | command, target, topic | meta | no |
| `explain` | Show the resolution and plan without executing. | command, expression | meta | no |
| `type` | Show the type or schema. | value, command output | meta | no |
| `install` | Add a verified package or artifact to a managed store. | plugin, package | mutation | yes |
| `load` | Activate an installed extension or runtime contribution. | plugin | mutation/context | yes |
| `unload` | Deactivate a loaded extension without uninstalling it. | plugin | mutation/context | yes |
| `verify` | Validate integrity, signature and contracts. | plugin, package | meta | no |
| `grant` | Create an explicit capability grant or lease. | capability | mutation/security | yes |
| `revoke` | Remove an existing capability grant or lease. | capability | mutation/security | yes |
| `ask` | Send a request to an explicitly selected assistant. | assistant | producer/context | no |
